questions.explanation:
Why This Is Asked
Assess ability to enforce data locality and rapid containment in a real-world multi-account setup, balancing access control with auditable forensics.

Key Concepts
- Region-scoped policies and SCPs to prevent cross-region data flow
- PrivateLink/VPCE for all data-plane services to avoid public endpoints
- Immutable audit trails (CloudTrail logs, S3 Object Lock)
- Cross-account governance and alerting for egress anomalies
- 60-second containment automation (SSM/Step Functions) to revoke credentials and quarantine data

Code Example
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": "s3:*",
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"StringNotEquals": {"aws:RequestedRegion": "us-east-1"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

Follow-up Questions
- How would you validate containment timing and avoid race conditions?
- What telemetry would you collect to detect policy drift and prove regional confinement during audits?
